verdict.rationale: ReelMimic generates 2D video from a stated request, but the documented flow always starts from a reference video, file or YouTube link, so pure text-prompt-to-video is not evidenced. Iteration is well documented: you chat to refine the storyboard plan before approving, request changes in chat (screenshots accepted), and leave timestamped comments on the finished video to send as a batch. Paused jobs also resume where they stopped. missing for 10: evidence that a text prompt alone (no reference video) can produce a clip, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the iteration loop.
